_comment: The course manifest: the single source of the structure. The build reads it to produce every page, the menus, the figure numbers, previous/next links and the sitemap. Beats are named by the id of the figure they carry (the internal data-fig id, which never changes); a beat is moved whole, with its text. 'tails' says where each old module's closing elements go (recap, bridge, Go deeper panels, mathematics panel, source list). Titles follow the restructuring plan (Titles and headings).
